name: print-social-cobalt-cake-order-steps-on-wavy-path
title: Four-step cake ordering guide on a wavy white path with pink starburst numbers
whatItIs: A cobalt 4:5 post where a winding white line links four cake-slice cut-outs, each with a pink serrated 'Step N' badge and a bold title with a one-sentence description in white. A small handwriting note 'It's simple :)' with an arrow sits at bottom left.
whatItMeans: Clear and appetising; the path makes a process read as an easy journey.
techniques: Use one continuous curved line to link steps in a zigzag.
Show a different product image at each step.
Number steps with pink starburst badges.

vocabulary.definition: Steps connected by a winding line.
A shaped label with a step number.
Alternating left and right placement of steps.
